limitations: Diagnostic only: API wrappers and timer queries add observer overhead. No performance gate verdict may be inferred.
Counts are submitted WebGL context API calls, plus ANGLE instancing methods if requested; they are not C++ Draw invocations or driver/GPU draw counts.
rAF buckets count calls since the previous diagnostic rAF callback. Native callbacks with submitted draw calls are labeled; exact native Draw boundaries are not exported.
GPU query elapsed surrounds sampled native callback command submission; it excludes browser compositor/presentation and may include GPU idle/CPU submission gaps.
Unavailable/disjoint/pending GPU queries are not zero GPU time. No GPU finish/readPixels/busy wait is used.
Native renderer mode, speed, fixture and actual progression require external native UI and screenshot evidence. A WebGL context alone does not distinguish native software/3D paths.
status: RECORDED comparative diagnostic; no performance verdict
